title: service-automation: a catalog descriptor saved active through PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/:name never gets the inert-connector audit warning until a later publish or restart
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Observed at objectstack main @ a557fa38 (examples/app-showcase scratch copy, `os dev`, sqlite file DB, admin session), beside integration-system.connector-descriptor-audit.

Reproduction (reproduced twice, qa_erp_rt and qa_erp_rt3):
1. Boot the stock showcase; confirm the boot log has no "declare actions but are not registered" line.
2. PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/qa_erp_rt  body {"name":"qa_erp_rt","label":"QA ERP runtime","type":"saas","enabled":true,"actions":[{"key":"get_y","label":"Get Y"}]}  → 200 "Saved connector 'qa_erp_rt' (env-wide, state=active)".
3. Wait (8 s). Expected: the `[Automation] N declarative connector(s) declare actions but are not registered … : qa_erp_rt …` warning, as a boot or a publish raises it. Actual: no warning line at all; the log shows only `[Registry] Registered connector: qa_erp_rt`.
4. Control: PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/qa_erp_rt2?mode=draft (same shape) then POST /api/v1/meta/connector/qa_erp_rt2/publish → the warning appears within seconds and names BOTH qa_erp_rt and qa_erp_rt2 — so the first descriptor was inert and unreported the whole time.
5. Corroboration that the save path does reconcile: PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/qa_inst_rt with provider 'rest' (active, no draft) materializes the instance (it appears `ready` on GET /api/v1/automation/connectors) — only the audit is skipped.

Mechanism: packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts — `queueConnectorMutationReconcile` (the #28002 `onMetadataMutation` path that "also covers a direct active save, which raises no reload anywhere") runs `reconcileDeclaredConnectors` only; `auditDeclaredConnectors` is wired on `kernel:ready` and `metadata:reloaded` alone (plugin.ts ~2830 and ~2865), so the direct-save door skips it.

Expected: the inert-descriptor audit runs wherever the connector reconcile runs (PD#10: declared ≠ delivered surfaces loudly), or the item/ADR states that only a publish re-audits.
Not a regression since 18.4.0: the save-path reconcile predates tag 181ad7d4 (git merge-base check).
